name: fortytimer
description: Read-only access to fortyTimer: flextime and vacation balances, work and project times, leave requests.
long_description: Connects Claude to a fortyTimer installation (requires the license module “fortyTimer API”). All tools are strictly read-only; visibility exactly matches the fortyTimer account of the token owner (admin: all users, supervisor: own approver groups, employee: self only). Free-text fields of sick-leave requests are never returned for data-protection reasons. The personal API token is created in fortyTimer under Profile → Security → API tokens and is stored in the operating system keychain.
